components: An ordered second nonneighbor separates two common ports from the remaining three. On the reconstructed double cover a vacuum-neutral additive integer readout reversing at the antipode selects a one-dimensional ray with primitive coefficients -2 and 3, up to sign.
candidates.declared_status: The charge hypotheses are inputs of this route; the integer ray is not a derivation of hypercharge or physical normalization.
missing_bridges: Derive an operational charge law and shared stable reference; establish dynamics, observed gauge actions and particles independently.
